<!-- Thanks for contributing! Fill in each section; delete the hints. -->

**Problem.** What does this change fix or add? Closes #

**Approach.** How you solved it, and anything you considered and rejected. If the PR has more than one commit, summarize them here.

**Where to look first.** The file or function a reviewer should start with.

**How you tested it.**

### Checklist (from our [git standards](https://github.com/hackingerror404/ServiceChaperone/blob/main/docs/git-standards.md))

- [ ] One logical change, small enough to review in one sitting
- [ ] Branch is named `type/issue#-short-desc`, and the description links the issue above
- [ ] Commit messages follow our conventions
- [ ] The program runs and the tests pass
- [ ] Docs updated if behavior changed
